scorecard.rationale: Boiled sweet potato with stew was tested in a run-based oxygen uptake study. A separate steamed sweet potato rice cake trial measured immediate cycling exertion and found no clear difference. Neither study measured fatigue severity in Parkinson disease. Chemical profiling confirms chlorogenic acids in roots as well as leaves and stems. The root analysis supplies neither a boiled-root exposure measure nor fatigue outcomes. The boil study's predicted oxygen uptake was inconclusive and the rice-cake trial measured exertion. No direction for the frozen fatigue claim is supported.
